interpretation: A controlled native TCP accept delay reproduces connect-stage resets at the host backlog bound without the SDK.
The unchanged 149750-event offered workload passes at 64 HTTP connections; driver waiting and explicit 503 refusals remain visible.
The former shutdown test could close before all injection HTTP requests finished; draining those requests removes the shutdown-stage false failures.
One paired experiment, not confidence intervals or an external QQ/deployment-capacity guarantee.
